Francesco Craighero

Senior Computational Biologist · CNAG, Barcelona

I am a Senior Computational Biologist in Holger Heyn’s Single Cell Genomics Group at CNAG, Barcelona, working on interpretable machine learning for computational biology.

Before joining CNAG, I was at EPFL, working with the Signal Processing Laboratory 2 (LTS2) and the Naef Lab. I obtained my PhD in Computer Science at the University of Milano-Bicocca. During my PhD, I spent six months as a visiting researcher at IBM Research Zurich.
